title: Glowing key
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff2a8' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd23f' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- key ring -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='9'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#fff6c9' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- shaft -->
  <rect x='42' y='40' width='48' height='11' rx='4' fill='#ffcc4d' transform='rotate(45 42 40)'/>
  <!-- shaft highlight -->
  <rect x='44' y='42' width='44' height='3.5' rx='1.75' fill='#fff6c9' transform='rotate(45 44 42)'/>
  <!-- teeth -->
  <rect x='72' y='52' width='8' height='18' rx='2.5' fill='#ffcc4d' transform='rotate(45 72 52)'/>
  <rect x='78' y='62' width='8' height='24' rx='2.5' fill='#ffcc4d' transform='rotate(45 78 62)'/>
  <!-- tooth highlights -->
  <rect x='74' y='53' width='3' height='15' rx='1.5' fill='#fff6c9' transform='rotate(45 74 53)'/>
  <rect x='80.5' y='63' width='3' height='21' rx='1.5' fill='#fff6c9' transform='rotate(45 80.5 63)'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M64 20 l3 7 l7 3 l-7 3 l-3 7 l-3 -7 l-7 -3 l7 -3 z' fill='#fff9d6'/>
  <path d='M22 68 l2 5 l5 2 l-5 2 l-2 5 l-2 -5 l-5 -2 l5 -2 z' fill='#fff9d6'/>
</svg>
